SELECT (
  SELECT json_build_object('id', id, 'vendor', vendor, 'invoiceNumber', "invoiceNumber")
  FROM "Expense"
  WHERE NULLIF(trim($1::text), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(trim($3::text), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(trim($4::text), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      (
        NULLIF(trim($2::text), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND "invoiceNumber" IS NOT NULL
        AND LOWER(vendor) = LOWER(trim($1::text))
        AND LOWER("invoiceNumber") = LOWER(trim($2::text))
        AND amount = $3::numeric
        AND UPPER(currency) = UPPER(trim($4::text))
      )
      OR
      (
        NULLIF(trim($2::text), '') IS NULL
        AND NULLIF(trim($5::text), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND "invoiceNumber" IS NULL
        AND LOWER(vendor) = LOWER(trim($1::text))
        AND "expenseDate"::date = $5::date
        AND amount = $3::numeric
        AND UPPER(currency) = UPPER(trim($4::text))
      )
    )
  ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS "matchedCandidate";

INSERT INTO "Expense" (
  "id",
  "idempotencyKey",
  "expenseDate",
  "vendor",
  "invoiceNumber",
  "description",
  "amount",
  "currency",
  "taxAmount",
  "subtotalAmount",
  "category",
  "validationStatus",
  "validationIssues",
  "sourceFileName",
  "createdAt",
  "updatedAt"
) VALUES (
  $1,
  NULLIF(trim($2::text), ''),
  NULLIF(trim($3::text), '')::timestamp,
  $4,
  $5,
  $6,
  NULLIF(trim($7::text), '')::numeric,
  $8,
  NULLIF(trim($9::text), '')::numeric,
  NULLIF(trim($10::text), '')::numeric,
  $11,
  $12,
  $13::jsonb,
  $14,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT ("idempotencyKey") DO UPDATE SET "updatedAt" = "Expense"."updatedAt"
RETURNING *;
